awareness of the importance and definitions of malnutrition, sarcopenia and cachexia are high among clinicians, however, there are barriers to identification and management of these conditions.

Australian cancer clinicians have high awareness of cancer-related malnourishment and sarcopenia; however, there are substantial barriers to delivering nutrition care.
